verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ChatGPT can search the web, gather current information, and compare sources, and that search results and citations appear in the chat when it uses web search. Community users confirm the web search feature launched and returned recent information, though one user reported an inaccurate weather answer. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how citations link back to sources, and independent corroboration of citation quality and grounding accuracy.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: Search results and citations appear in the chat when ChatGPT uses web search.
Search the web, browse websites, compare sources, read files, analyze data, and summarize findings.
Browser lets ChatGPT open websites, gather current information, and take action while you stay in control.
